items.operation: Apply the expand-only shadow-run migration on the target PostgreSQL database
items.evidence: Flyway validated 21 migrations and recorded V20 success=true before the runtime service was replaced.

items.operation: Create a DRAFT shadow run with an independent engineer identity
items.evidence: DRAFT/r1 pinned one PUBLISHED and active rule, its published topology, the validated current point-catalog snapshot and all nine start-readiness checks.

items.operation: Start the run from the real ADP BPI page
items.evidence: The page persisted RUNNING/r2 by legacy-ticket:admin and rendered the updated state.

items.operation: Review ten matching CLOSED_RAW shadow batches
items.evidence: One review was submitted through the page and nine through the same adapter contract; activeReviews=10, acceptedBoundaries=19/20 and boundaryAgreement=0.95.
Automatic and reference totals are both 1000 t; cumulative, mean and maximum quantity deviation are all 0 percent.

items.operation: Complete observation from the real page
items.evidence: The run entered EVALUATING/r13 only after the configured duration and ten-review gates were satisfied.

items.operation: Attempt approval while a CRITICAL data-quality incident is unresolved
items.evidence: The page disabled approval and the service returned UNRESOLVED_CRITICAL_DATA_QUALITY without changing the run revision.

items.operation: Acknowledge, assign and resolve the controlled incident from the real data-quality page
items.evidence: The incident ended RESOLVED/r3 with preserved event, action and audit history; the approval action reopened only after resolution.

items.operation: Approve from the real page with an administrator different from the creator
items.evidence: The final state is APPROVED/r14; creator is the controlled engineer and approver is legacy-ticket:admin.

items.operation: Query PostgreSQL directly for the accepted lifecycle and metrics
items.evidence: The pre-cleanup query returned APPROVED/r14, 691202 observed seconds, 10 reviews, 0.95 boundary agreement, 0 quantity deviation and zero unresolved CRITICAL incidents.

items.operation: Query action audit and successful command idempotency
items.evidence: PostgreSQL contained 16 attributable audit rows and exactly 10 COMPLETED/200 idempotency rows; the deliberate 422 was not stored as a successful command.

items.operation: Verify the shadow workflow does not perform production write-back
items.evidence: All ten source batches remained CLOSED_RAW with qualityGate=NOT_APPLICABLE and wmsStatus=NOT_REQUESTED; no WOM, QCS, WMS, PLC or DCS command was issued.

items.operation: Capture real browser network and runtime errors
items.evidence: The page captured 57 BPI responses (51 GET and 6 POST), all 2xx, with zero console errors, page errors and request failures.

items.operation: Replace stale target service and adapter artifacts with byte-for-byte verified builds
items.evidence: The service r2 JAR removed the retired snapshot.ready_point_count reference; the adapter r2 JAR added the shadow-runs collection/action allowlist. Both target containers are healthy with zero recent ERROR logs.

items.operation: Delete only the controlled tenant and marker fixtures after evidence capture
items.evidence: Shadow runs, reviews, incidents, batches, outbox rows, rules, topologies, catalogs, calibrations and idempotency all returned zero remaining rows.

runtimeDefectsFoundAndFixed.rootCause: The first target image contained a stale JAR compiled before the V17 operational readiness query stopped referencing snapshot.ready_point_count.
runtimeDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Rebuilt the current Java 17 source, proved the focused PostgreSQL lifecycle test, verified the class bytes and deployed the r2 service image.

runtimeDefectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: GET /bpi-api/shadow-runs returned 403 and the real page could not render the created run
runtimeDefectsFoundAndFixed.rootCause: The first target adapter image contained a stale Java 8 JAR built before shadow-run routes were added to BpiRoutePolicy.
runtimeDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Ran 20 Java 8 adapter tests, verified the packaged route regex and deployed the r2 adapter image.

boundaries: The eight-day database time compression proves deterministic gate behavior only; it is not seven to fourteen days of continuous field operation.
The rule, topology, point catalog, incident and ten batches were controlled target fixtures, not authoritative real-device and WOM same-marker production facts.
The workflow is deliberately shadow-only and did not write WOM, QCS, WMS, PLC or DCS production state.
Real field calibration, continuous monotonic DEVICE or GATEWAY source sequence, real END boundaries and same-scope candidate or batch creation remain open.
No credential, ticket, internal JWT secret, database password, dump or runtime binary is stored in this record.
